title: Hurry Up and Die
description: A race against the clock to beat the game as quickly as possible, however victory may not be as simple as it seems.
body:
**_A race against the clock to beat the game as quickly as possible, however victory may not be as simple as it seems._**

You are a test subject dropped in one of countless simulations, and you have one goal:
# Win.

The longer it takes, the harder mobs get. However, it is not as simple as reaching the end portal with a few eyes of ender and calling it a day. There are various eyes you must either encounter or go out of your way to obtain, while surviving the ever increasing hostility of the world.
### _But don't worry, player._
You are significantly buffed as well, given enhanced movement and combat abilities that differ each run to provide an interesting gameplay loop.
### _Do you have what it takes to succeed?_
‎ 
> This pack is in **VERY** early development, while playable and definitely fun, there is so much more yet to do. See you at the finish line!
